blockingFindings.title: Run-ID plan allocates the next value but does not validate uniqueness, monotonicity, or three-digit exhaustion
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Extend Q3 with a pure Run-ID parse/validate/allocation contract and fixture tests. It must validate the complete YYYYMMDD-NNN-action grammar; reject Delivery-wide duplicate NNN values across Change and _delivery sources; reject a requested/candidate NNN that is not greater than every allocated NNN; preserve allowed gaps; and fail explicitly rather than emit an invalid ID when the next value exceeds 999. Keep filesystem traversal and atomic create/persist behavior in C1; B1 should operate on supplied directory-name/Run-ID fixtures and expose the fail-closed validation result.
